listing.name: Army of Two: The 40th Day — Libre40 (eu-maxwelllucas)
listing.summary: Upstream describes single-player gameplay. Movies show a black screen; waiting for them to finish allows startup to continue. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Army of Two: The 40th Day Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own Army of Two: The 40th Day ISO, then follow upstream instructions to build the SDK, generate code and compile the Windows player.

warnings: Upstream describes single-player gameplay. Movies show a black screen; waiting for them to finish allows startup to continue.
